summary: IMMUTEP Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 14, 2026, reporting a clinical update for its immunotherapy eftilagimod alfa in first-line non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer. The update includes positive mature overall survival data from the INSIGHT-003 Phase I trial (median OS 30.9 months) and a root cause analysis update for the discontinued TACTI-004 Phase III trial. No financial terms, transactions, or special-situation structural changes are disclosed. This is a routine clinical progress report by a foreign private issuer, analogous to a press release, and does not trigger any special-situations category.
